message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 * * * *' # Every hour. Ref https://crontab.guru/examples.html
name: Scrape Data
jobs:
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@master
    - name: Cache npm dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v3
      with:
        path: ~/.npm
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-node-
    - name: Build
      run: npm install
    - name: Scrape
      run: npm run action
    - uses: mikeal/publish-to-github-action@master
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} # GitHub sets this for you
",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs npm install on every scheduled hourly run and the repository includes package-lock.json, matching the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE preconditions (repeated dependency fetching measurable; lockfile available as cache input). Adding an actions/cache step keyed on package-lock.json reuses dependency downloads across runs while keeping npm install and all existing steps intact, preserving build/test coverage without weakening permissions or adding privileged actions, secrets, publishing/deployment operations, or new network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
